Hi all,

Starting December 1, payroll will run on the 15th and the last business day of each month instead of every other Friday. The change will not effect your total pay; it only changes the timing.

If the new schedule creates a hardship, HR can accomodate a one-time advance in December. Email Priya Venkataraman by November 15 to request one.

Thanks,
The People Team

labels.notes: "will not effect your pay" needs the verb "affect"; unambiguous because a verb is required after "will not".
